overfit_risks: LoCoMo set-question lexical rules were written after all ten conversations were read; split alone does not make this feature blind. Generalisation audit reports 304/1540 fires and 183 outside target list set.
2-before/4-after turn windows assume short dialogue turns; other corpora have long assistant turns or filler. LoCoMo gains came with distractor regressions.
Speaker voting parses capitalized name prefixes; many chat datasets use role metadata. The harness has historically written all turns as user, limiting role-aware transfer claims.
Relative-date annotation and English shape/refusal regexes can mis-handle absent timestamps, other languages, or false premises.
Retry-refusal and LoCoMo-tuned rubric can inflate answerable QA while harming abstention; date pre-check changes score without changing memory behavior.
Proxy gold in HaluMem, LaMP and MemoryCD and reconstructed MAB gold must not be pooled with native turn gold; OP-Bench retrieval proxies do not establish response quality.
Historical baseline commit 5f186e3 differs from current HEAD and dirty worktree; no current score is established.
